prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite for a new plant in the original 2009 Plants vs. Zombies lawn-defense game. Create one single original character called Lantern-shroom, designed to sit naturally beside Sun-shroom and Fume-shroom. A squat cute mushroom with a cream-colored stalk, two clearly readable black oval eyes looking to the right, tiny determined eyebrows and a small simple mouth. Broad rounded desaturated blue-green mushroom cap, slightly drooping like the original game's mushroom silhouettes. The cap has a few thick organic ribs and warm honey-amber glowing panels, as though the mushroom itself is a little paper lantern; no handheld item. Two small stubby feet at the base. Original game's hand-painted 2D cartoon rendering: bold dark charcoal irregular outlines, simple soft painted shading, muted natural colors, exaggerated clean silhouette, a little asymmetry and charming slightly goofy face. Front three-quarter game view facing right, whole character fully visible, isolated and centered, cap occupies upper half and face clearly visible below. Compact roughly square silhouette designed to remain readable at 70 by 80 pixels. Sprite fills about 80 percent of square canvas, with clear transparent padding all around. All background pixels genuinely transparent. No ground, no scenery, no text, no logo, no seed packet, no border, no cast shadow, no external glow cloud or particles. Only one plant and only one pose. Make the cap's amber light look warm but keep crisp dark outlines and solid painted shapes.
scope: New Lantern-shroom artwork; existing game assets remain unchanged.
